description: Scientific-owner accepted OG/refactor science-map and diagnostic bounds with separate raw and Wiener-filtered map policy.
rationale: Raw observation and coadd map products retain the strict behavior-preserving bound.
Wiener-filtered coadds use a separate 1.5% RMS-relative bound after the scientific owner accepted the measured 0.99% filtered-map difference as negligible and requested continued creep monitoring.
Discrete flags, counts, identifiers, and classifications remain exact.
Near-zero detector medians require both absolute and fractional bounds.
This profile does not authorize future changes to science algorithms or defaults.
